title: Approval card: nothing happens until I press
evidence: It works; its look is ours. useConversation.ts takes Barkpark's approval_requested (plan mode asks for the plan, then each step) and Transcript.tsx shows a plain card: what the bot asks, the plan, command or file text, Deny and Allow; nothing is sent until a press (chat/api.ts answerApproval). A reload in the middle of an ask brings the card back from Barkpark's stored row while the bot's state is blocked. Live: npm run turn:live -- --approve (2026-11-13: 2 cards allowed, the file was in the bot's folder). Finding: the oracle did not ask. 1.0.3, 2026-11-14 (two sends, recipes ask-leave and ask-leave-2): it made and deleted a file in its home folder without a card. Its Permissions settings name Always Ask, Allow without Asking and Auto-Review. Needs the owner's decision: set the oracle to Always Ask and allow a send to capture its card (no sends are left), or accept our card's look as ours.
gate: behaviour 5 rules (scripts/behaviour.mjs: card and no answer; Allow once; the card goes when confirmed; Deny; an ask after a reload); live parity/live/approve.json. No Gate A: never captured
